description: Tells Flash Console what Claude Code is doing, and brings in the FlashTeams briefing when a session starts, over a private connection on this computer (a socket, or a named pipe on Windows). Lets a plain flashteams command run without a Claude Code permission prompt, since Flash Console asks before the changes that need it. In a Flash Console pane, puts Claude Code's permission prompts, and an MCP server asking to go ahead, on a card with buttons as well as in the terminal.

hooks.command: $(exit 0); sh -c '{ set +eux; } 2>/dev/null; f=$1; shift; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 0; sh "$f" "$@" 2>/dev/null; exit 0' sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/flashteams-hook.sh" claude SessionStart
